about: Every carried item that isn't gear, one row each: python3 art/items/export_items.py writes game/Code/Remastered/ItemData.dm. Weapons and armour are art/enhance/catalogue.json. Every item in the game, and which can be adopted: ITEM_LIST.md (python3 art/items/list_items.py). Planning: planning/COMBINE_PLAN_2026-10-28.md (Making a new item).

fields.name: what the game calls it
fields.kind: food | potion | poison | herb | material | tool | misc: what the game already does with that kind comes with it (food is eaten, a potion drunk, a poison coats a blade)
fields.picture: "pictures/<file>.png" (32 x 32, packed into Icons/Remastered/Items/catalogue.dmi), or {"dmi": "Cave.dmi", "state": "Toxic"} for a picture the game has
fields.weight: as the game's items (a log is 10)
fields.vars: its own numbers by the game's variable names: {"FoodPower": 30, "PoisonContent": 25}
fields.recipe: optional: {"station": "Carpentry", "skill": "Woodwork", "level": 5, "materials": {"wood": 2}, "makes": 1, "who": {"only": ["Elf"]}}; stations Forge, Bone crafting, Leatherworks, Carpentry, Gem cutter; skills Smithing, Leatherwork, Bone craft, Woodwork, Gem cutting; materials as the gear catalogue's
fields.adopt: an item the game already has, by its type name: "/obj/Items/ores/Iron". The row holds that kind's values and needs only id (anything it leaves out comes from its group); the type name never changes, so saves and all its code (its menu, what it does) still find it. export_items.py --adopt moves one in; art/items/ITEM_LIST.md (list_items.py) says which can

items.desc: Rock salt. Carried, it keeps the food in the same bag four times longer; left on a stockpile, the food there. A lump keeps ten pieces for an hour, then it's used up. Double-click it in a bag to salt the carried food for good (eight times longer, four pieces a lump).

items.name: Stake
